messages.subject:
ANNOUNCEMENT: Airflow Summit Online Reconnect 2026 registration and
 CFP open
messages.body:
Hello Airflow community,

You are invited to join us in the *Airflow Summit Online Reconne**ct*, 
the online edition of Airflow Summit — designed for data practitioners, 
everyone in the data orchestration space and the Airflow community who 
can't always make it to the in-person event.


*

📅 November 4 & 5, 2026

💻 Online

🌍 Free access

*https://airflowsummit.org/onlinereconnect/ *

*
*

✅ 10+ talks across 3 tracks over 2 days

✅ New sessions - CFP is open!

✅ Global focus

✅ Virtual expo hall — connect directly with Google Cloud, Astronomer, 
and BMC

✅ Virtual swag and prizes for active participants

✅ Accessible recordings

✅ Access to the Slack community

*
*

*Send your talk proposal*

*
*

The CFP is still open until September 19. We'll announce the preliminary 
program on September 23. Since this is an online extension of the 
Airflow Summit, the same 3 tracks that were introduced for this year's 
edition will apply:

*

 1. *Builder Track*: If your talk focuses on building, operating, or
    scaling Airflow, whether you're writing DAGs, managing deployments,
    tuning performance, or keeping pipelines reliable at scale, submit
    it to the Builder Track. This track is ideal for sessions that share
    hands-on techniques, architectural patterns, lessons learned in
    production, or deep dives into orchestration and platform engineering.
 2. *Data & AI Application Track*: If your talk explores how Airflow
    powers data products, analytics workflows, ML pipelines, or
    downstream ML and AI outcomes, submit it to the Data & AI
    Application Track. Sessions in this track should demonstrate how
    teams integrate Airflow with modern data and ML ecosystems,
    including experimentation, quality, metrics, model training, or
    analytics operations.
 3. *Data Strategy Track*: If your talk covers the organizational or
    strategic side of Airflow, such as team structure, governance,
    observability, adoption planning, cross-functional alignment, or
    long-term platform strategy, submit it to the Data Strategy Track.
    This track is best for leaders sharing frameworks, decisions, and
    lessons that help organizations scale Airflow effectively and
    sustainably.

**

**

*

Submit your talk here: 
*https://sessionize.com/airflow-summit-online-reconnect-2026 *

*
*

See you in November!

The Airflow Summit Team

*
